faqs.question: What does the project brief include?
faqs.answer: A readable document with your intended outcome, project type, delivery preference, requirements and work sequence. You can also download the kit’s JSON record, with empty evidence for your builder to complete as the work is verified.

faqs.question: Can I use my existing website platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start with the editing experience and integrations you need. Framer and Webflow can support a website layer; authenticated applications, complex data and agent features may need additional architecture.

faqs.question: Where do the details I enter go?
faqs.answer: The brief is prepared in this page and downloaded only when you choose. This example does not send the details to a server or save them between visits.

faqs.question: Is this a published agency offer?
faqs.answer: This is a working Studio edition under development. The brief builder is usable; commercial packages and individual native platform editions require their own release review.
